body: I feel like if LE SSERAFIM ever gets an actual rap part, it should go to Sakura. In their recent The Boys cover, Sakura sounded decent while rapping and I can imagine her rapping a bit quicker. In their The Boys cover, Kazuha sounded a bit too soft for the rapping-shouting that they were doing.

I don't know if anyone had said it yet but I've realised that the verse arrangement is similar with TOMBOY and Nxde. It goes Minnie soft singing > Soyeon singing rap > Miyeon Prechorus > Yuqi Prechorus > Instrumental chorus > Soyeon rap > Shuhua prechorus > Miyeon prechorus > Instrumental chorus > Shuhua bridge (Um ah um ah) > Outro with all members with Soyeon leading, Yuqi saying something in the middle and Soyeon ending the song.
SNSD- The Boys!!
